data.name: The most famous Acoustic cafes in Hanoi
data.raw_name: The most famous Acoustic cafes in Hanoi
data.raw_text: No noise is as hot as Saigon, Hanoi has a romantic and classic look. Therefore, cultural and artistic activities here also have their own style. After a tiring day of work, there is nothing better than sipping a cup of coffee with melodious Acoustic music.

data.name: Serene Cafe & Lounge
data.raw_text: Serein Café & Lounge is an emerging cafe for young people in Hanoi. What is unique about this cafe is the perfect view of the train tracks. This is the perfect place to sip cocktails and enjoy the unspoiled scenery of Long Bien Bridge
